notes.title: New Game Witches Brew Is Available NOW!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello there, alchemists and witches![/h3]

We bring you enchanting news today: our newest game, Witches Brew, has just been released on Steam! Head on over to the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1008230/Witches_Brew/]Steam Page [/url][/b]and get the game now! 


Witches Brew is the story of Selene, a coven witch traveling from the big city in search of adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35214477/7ace7e17e3e767bc52b6aaa2b4d3424a8c81bff8.png[/img]
[i]Get ready to dominate potion making and the sexiest girls~[/i]
[hr][/hr]
Gorgeous girls, an enchanting world full of magic and an amazing story all await you! Head on ahead to [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1008230/Witches_Brew/]The Steam Page[/url][/b] and get the game right now!

I know you’re not a witch yourself, but you still encountered such a magical opportunity. You’re talented.


Dharker Studios
